listings.title: Moorestown Estate Sale: 1972 Williams Pinball, Vintage Toys, Mid-Century & Retro Finds
listings.description: B&B Estate Sales is pleased to present a wonderful estate sale in Moorestown, New Jersey, featuring an eclectic mix of vintage collectibles, mid-century furniture, and nostalgic retro items. Among the highlights of this sale is a highly sought-after 1972 Williams "Spanish Eyes" pinball machine, boasting vibrant, psychedelic graphics on both the backglass and cabinet. Collectors will also find an array of vintage toys and recreational items, including an Aurora Model Motoring Real Racing slot car set in its original box, a classic Wonder Horse spring rocking horse, a vintage Welsh baby stroller, and retro plastic snowboards from Riva and Sledz. For those looking to furnish or decorate, the home offers a beautiful French Provincial style dining set with a cream-painted finish and gold trim, a set of six mid-century folding chairs with teal vinyl seats, and a classic Windsor-style armchair. Decorative highlights include a stunning Tiffany-style stained glass table lamp with a floral tulip motif, a colorful songbird stained glass window panel, and vintage holiday decor. Audiophiles and media enthusiasts will appreciate the vintage Garrard Synchro-Lab 72B turntable, a selection of classic vinyl records, and quality home audio components from Sony and Samsung. This sale will take place on-site in Moorestown, NJ (08057). We accept all major credit cards, Venmo, as well as cash. Please check back for final dates, times, and parking instructions. We look forward to seeing you there!
